title: Challenges: Environmental Degradation  [Body]  A country that has experienced environmental degradation due to an uneven distribution of resources is Nigeria. Nigeria has faced severe environmental degradation even though the country is rich in oil reserves. The oil industry, which is a primary source of revenue for the country, has led to significant environmental damage due to activities such as oil spills, gas flaring, and inadequate waste management practices.
